name: HassClimateSetTemperature
description: Sets the desired indoor temperature. Triggered by: adjust, change, decrease, increase, make, set, turn down, turn, turn up. Examples: set the office thermostat to 20 degrees.

name: HassLightSet
description: Sets the brightness or color of a light. Triggered by: change, set, decrease, increase, make, turn down, turn up, turn, change brightness, decrease brightness, increase brightness, brightness of. Examples: set the bedroom lamp brightness to 50%.

name: HassMediaPause
description: Pauses a media player. Triggered by: pause. Examples: pause the TV.

description: Sets the volume of a media player. Triggered by: turn, change, decrease, increase, make, set, turn down, turn up. Examples: set the TV volume to 90 percent.

name: HassTurnOff
description: Turns off a device or entity. Triggered by: deactivate, change off, bring, change, close, switch off, bring off, close down, close up, turn off, lower down, unlock. Examples: turn off the overhead light in the kitchen; turn off the play corner lights in the kitchen; close the curtain left in the living room; close the main valve in the kitchen; unlock the front door in the kitchen; turn off the overhead light; turn off the play corner lights; close the sliding door.

name: HassTurnOn
description: Turns on a device or entity. Triggered by: activate, change on, light up, bring, change, switch on, bring on, lift, lift up, open up, turn on, open. Examples: turn on the overhead light in the kitchen; turn on the play corner lights in the kitchen; open the curtain left in the living room; open the main valve in the kitchen; lock the front door in the kitchen; turn on the overhead light; turn on the play corner lights; open the sliding door.
